verdict.rationale: Kimi documents agents that complete multi-step work autonomously: Kimi Code reads, edits, runs commands and "autonomously complete[s] development tasks", and the assistant offers an Agent mode, Agent clusters and Agent tasks. The evidence never shows these running in the background while the user is away, nor a handoff back for review; they are described as conversational or terminal sessions, and the help-page entries are only topic titles. Missing for 10: documented background or asynchronous execution, a review/return workflow (e.g., task completion notifications or diffs for approval), and hands-on corroboration of long-running autonomous tasks.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review
